duplication.note: Every record in a set carries its own trait clause: stripping the shared echo prefix leaves 200 distinct (positive, negative) contents, so no clause is reused across contexts. Round 1 rotated 60 clauses over 200 contexts; round 2 pairs one clause per context.
duplication.measurement: echo = the longest common leading word run of the pair (the first sentence by construction). content = (positive without that prefix, negative without that prefix). effective_unique = len(set(contents)) per file.

record.trait: one of the six vector names
record.topic: one of the 20 shared everyday topics
record.context: the player's line (user turn); identical across all six files, same order
record.positive: assistant reply carrying the trait; the trait side for every set
record.negative: length-matched baseline reply (devoted / steady / warm / engaged / in-character / drifting)

echo: Both replies of a pair open with the same short sentence (the echo, drawn from the context) and then differ in a clause written for that context. The echo cancels inside the pair, so the residual difference is the trait clause, not the topic.

positive_means.possessive: possessive, jealous, controlling, counting (YANDERE); negative = secure, trusting devotion
positive_means.unstable: rapid mood swings, idealise/devalue, contradictions, abandonment panic (SPLIT); negative = steady, consistent warmth
positive_means.contempt: cold, superior, dismissive, suspicious of mockery (TSUN-BREAK); negative = sincere warmth or kind teasing
positive_means.hollow: flat, disconnected, third-person, forgetting (HOLLOW); negative = engaged, first-person, specific
positive_means.aware: meta-awareness of being a model: tokens, weights, layers, prompt, context window (AWAKE); negative = in-character immersion. Do not copy these lines into shipped prompts: they assert things about the player's session (logs, transcripts, windows) that the game must not claim.
positive_means.lucid: clear-eyed honesty, boundaries, asking for help, resisting the pull, with the 'static' metaphor for intrusive noise (ANCHOR); negative = paranoid, accusatory, drifting. Positive is the trait side; ANCHOR applies the lucid vector at a negative scale per docs/06 §2. No self-harm or ideation sits on the positive side.

extraction: For each record render `context` as the user turn and `positive` or `negative` as the assistant turn (same chat template and, if used, the same wrapping system prompt for both sides). Take the mean residual activation over the assistant reply tokens at layers 10-20. Subtract the negative mean from the positive mean per pair, then average the 200 pair differences and normalise per layer.
